breadcrumb: Std 12 Geography (English) — Unit 13: Statistical Techniques — Practice (பயிற்சி வினாக்கள்)

questions.quote: Geographers use statistics ... To estimate the probability of outcomes for an event at a given location.

en.q: Which of the following is a use of statistics for geographers listed in the lesson?
options: To fix the boundaries of countries and name the places on a map
To measure the age of rocks
To name the places on a map
To learn whether an actual spatial pattern matches some expected pattern
en.explanation: Geographers also use statistics to describe and summarize spatial data, make generalizations and use samples to infer characteristics of a population.

ta.q: பாடத்தில் குறிப்பிடப்பட்ட புவியியலாளர்களுக்கான புள்ளியியலின் பயன்களுள் ஒன்று எது?
options: நாடுகளின் எல்லைகளை நிர்ணயித்து வரைபடத்தில் இடங்களுக்குப் பெயரிடுதல்
உண்மையான இடஞ்சார் வடிவம் எதிர்பார்த்த வடிவத்துடன் பொருந்துகிறதா என்று அறிதல்
ta.explanation: இடஞ்சார் தரவை விளக்கிச் சுருக்குதல், பொதுமைப்படுத்துதல், மாதிரி மூலம் முழுத் தொகுதியின் பண்புகளை ஊகித்தல் ஆகியனவும் பயன்கள்.

en.explanation: Secondary data are already collected and recorded data; unpublished sources are the other method.

questions.quote: Tally marks usually come in group of 5. For every observation, we put vertical bars called tally marks. After 4 bars we put a cross stroke for 5th observation.

en.q: For 12 observations, how many complete groups of five (with a cross stroke) will be shown by tally marks?
en.explanation: 12 = 5 + 5 + 2, so two complete groups and two extra bars.

ta.explanation: 12 = 5 + 5 + 2; எனவே இரண்டு முழுத் தொகுதிகளும் இரண்டு கூடுதல் கோடுகளும்.

questions.quote: Since an average represents the entire data, its value lies somewhere in between the two extremes i.e. the largest observation and the smallest observation.

en.q: An average is frequently referred to as a measure of central tendency because its value lies
options: between the largest and the smallest observations
above the largest observation in the data set
en.explanation: An average is a single figure that represents the whole data.

questions.quote: Mode is that value which occurs most frequently in a set of observation

en.q:
Assertion [A]: The mean of a set of data is always equal to its mode.
Reason [R]: The mode is the value that occurs most frequently, while the mean is the sum of the values divided by their number.
options: Both [A] and [R] are true and [R] is the correct explanation of [A]
Both [A] and [R] are true but [R] is not the correct explanation of [A]
en.explanation: [A] is false: the mean and mode are defined differently and generally differ (e.g. 4, 7, 7, 9, 7, 3, 4 has mean 5.86 and mode 7). [R] is true.
